item.text:
The page will move from a spacious introduction to a two-column project gallery, then into a quieter reading layout.

- **Design read:** editorial portfolio for prospective clients and readers; new identity. Visual variety 6/10, motion 2/10, density 5/10, asset dependence 3/10, brand fidelity 2/10.
- **System:** warm ivory `#F5F3EC`, forest `#294D40`, charcoal `#252C28`, muted sage and clay illustrations; Newsreader headings with DM Sans body text.
- **Craft:** 8px spacing rhythm, fine dividers, nearly square surfaces, restrained illustration shadows, and brief hover transitions. Large headings will scale down for phones, with all navigation links remaining visible.
